text: registry open. engine function accepts transitions (lsa_transitions object counts) ..., returns named list least K×KK \times K matrices obs, exp, prob, adj_res p. K×KK \times K matrix returns becomes extra column transitions(). example defines Pearson residuals, (O−E)/E(O - E)/\sqrt{E}, omit margin correction adjusted residual. Pearson engine flags seven transitions classical engine, smaller values (Active Active: 13.5 21.7), adjusted residual divides smaller standard deviation accounts fixed margins. Pearson residual standard normal null understates departures; shown template, alternative classical engine. Columns engine return, Yule’s Q kappa, NA. engine stays registered session; remove unregister_lsa_engine().
code: pearson_engine <- function(transitions, ...) {   obs <- transitions$obs   expected <- outer(rowSums(obs), colSums(obs)) / sum(obs)   residual <- (obs - expected) / sqrt(expected)   list(obs = obs, exp = expected, prob = obs / rowSums(obs),        adj_res = residual, p = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(residual))) } register_lsa_engine("pearson", pearson_engine,                     description = title: Transfer entropy between states
text: transfer_entropy() computes plug-Shannon entropies pooled (target future, target history, source value) triples. sequence contributes triples fit inside , lag never crosses one sequence next, triples missing value dropped. returned table one row per ordered pair columns: te: transfer entropy bits. te_normalised: te divided target’s leftover uncertainty H(Yt+ℓ∣Yt(k))H(Y_{t+\ell} \mid Y_t^{(k)}), share target’s past leaves unexplained source explains (0 1). te_effective: te minus mean transfer entropy surrogates, bias-corrected value (surrogate test ). p: surrogate p-value (surrogate test ). n: number pooled triples. what: Fit a lag sequential analysis model — lsa
title: Fit a lag sequential analysis model — lsa
text: lsa() fits lag sequential analysis model event sequences, wide sequence tables, transition-count matrices, long event logs, sequence objects packages. Lag sequential analysis (Sackett, 1979; Bakeman & Gottman, 1997) tests whether, stream coded events, one state follows another less often chance predicts. transitions observed given lag counted table antecedent () consequent () states; expected table derived hypothesis two independent; cell tested adjusted residual (Haberman, 1979), standard normal deviate positive transition -represented negative avoided. significant cells define lag transition network, tablewise likelihood-ratio Pearson tests show whether sequential dependence . every cell, lsa() estimates observed expected counts, transition probability, adjusted residual p-value, Yule's Q, kappa lift. engine selects test: classical analysis Bakeman Quera (1995) default; two-cell (2 x 2) test odds ratios; Sackett's bidirectional test symmetrised table; parallel non-parallel dominance tests Sackett (1979) Wampold (1984). Self-transitions cells occur construction declared structural zeros, expected table fitted iterative proportional fitting (Christensen, 1997). group, one model fitted per group shared state set groups can compared. returns lsa object, group lsa_group object holding one fit per group. fit read transitions(), nodes(), tests(), initial() transition_probabilities(), drawn plot.lsa(). fit several lags use lsa_lags(); assess transitions use bootstrap_lsa(), certainty_lsa() permute_lsa(); compare groups use compare_lsa(). engine wrappers lsa_classical(), lsa_two_cell(), lsa_bidirectional(), lsa_parallel_dominance() lsa_nonparallel_dominance() lsa() engine fixed return object.

title: Remove a registered engine — unregister_lsa_engine
code: placeholder <- function(transitions, ...) {   obs <- transitions$obs   expected <- outer(rowSums(obs), colSums(obs)) / sum(obs)   list(obs = obs, exp = expected, prob = obs / rowSums(obs),        adj_res = obs * 0, p = obs * 0 + 1) } register_lsa_engine("placeholder", placeholder,                     description = "Placeholder engine") unregister_lsa_engine("placeholder") list_lsa_engines() #>                    name #> 1         bidirectional #> 2             classical #> 3 nonparallel_dominance #> 4    parallel_dominance #> 5              two_cell #>                                                            description requires #> 1 Sackett's bidirectional / matched-pair test on the symmetrized table          #> 2                    Bakeman & Quera classical lag sequential analysis          #> 3       Sackett's non-parallel-dominance (observed-SE + binomial) test          #> 4                      Sackett's parallel-dominance (expected-SE) test          #> 5                  2x2 cell test (odds ratio, log-OR Wald z, Yule's Q)

title: lagdynamics 0.35.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-11-18 release collects changes since CRAN release 0.32.

title: lagdynamics 0.35.0
text: summary() fit now returns summary.lsa object instead printing fit matrices. object holds two tidy tables, one-row overview per-state activity table; prints shown, .data.frame(summary(fit), = "nodes") returns either table. Grouped fits unchanged (one row per group). transition_probabilities() now returns tidy data frame columns , prob (one row per pair states; grouped fits gain leading group column) instead matrix list matrices. .data.frame() compare_lsa() bayes_compare_lsa() results gains = "global" omnibus test, reliability_lsa() results = "summary" one-row summary replicates.

title: lagdynamics 0.35.0
text: reliability_lsa() stability_lsa() now treat documented degenerate case (resample transitions) failed replicate; error reported caller. number failed replicates stored result (n_failed) shown print().

title: lagdynamics 0.35.0
text: User-facing errors classed conditions: lagdynamics_bad_input, lagdynamics_needs_events, lagdynamics_no_transitions, lagdynamics_unknown_engine, lagdynamics_unsupported_option, lagdynamics_incompatible_fits, lagdynamics_missing_package lagdynamics_ipf_infeasible, also class lagdynamics_error. Console output plot subtitles use ASCII replacements block glyph, superscript G^2 middle dot session UTF-8. transfer_entropy(seed = ) bayes_compare_lsa(seed = ) restore caller’s random number stream exit.

title: lagdynamics 0.35.0
text: New documentation structure. Vignettes: lag sequential analysis, lag transition networks, evaluating transitions comparing groups. Guides (package website): complete workflow, event logs interoperability, engines, lags structural zeros, plotting, transfer entropy. Case studies: course engagement, regulation high low achieving groups, AI behaviour programming sessions.

title: lagdynamics 0.32
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-21

title: lagdynamics 0.32
text: transitions() now reads inference results, fitted models. accepts output bootstrap_lsa(), certainty_lsa(), stability_lsa(), permute_lsa(), compare_lsa(), bayes_compare_lsa() lsa_lags(), returns tidy one-row-per-transition data frame. significant = TRUE keeps transitions method flags, sort = "strength" orders method’s signed effect. Previously per-transition table inference result reachable .data.frame(), print methods show header summary alone. transitions() generic now transitions(fit, ...), class declares arguments backed columns actually . Existing calls fit unaffected.

title: lagdynamics 0.32
text: Vignettes restore user’s options() changing digits, CRAN requires. Vignettes read every result transitions() rather coercing .data.frame(), select rows significant argument rather subsetting. Removed citations, reference lists, DOIs, documentation URLs linked author metadata 0.31 added shipped vignettes.

title: lagdynamics 0.31
text: Prepared package first CRAN submission. Moved ggplot2 cograph Suggests Imports plotting surface works box; plotting examples now run checks. analytical core still depends base R. Added dedicated interoperability vignette covering wide data, long event logs, tna, Nestimate, cograph, lsa_to_tna(). Added linked author metadata Dynalytics framework links shipped vignettes. Restored lsa_to_tna() handing lsa fit tna tooling. Added ingestion Nestimate::build_network() netobjects prepared sequence data. Stored bundled engagement data data frame tna::tna(engagement) works directly. Removed dead package-site URLs CRAN-visible metadata. Added future CRAN installation instructions README. Included NEWS.md source package.

title: lagdynamics 0.3.0
text: Added integration tests cograph, Nestimate, Dynalytics evidence surface. Added native TNA-style aliases: weights = "tna" weights = "relative" now map transition probabilities. Updated plotting documentation vignettes use weights = "tna" probability-weighted transition networks. intro: conceptual overview package map. lagdynamics: concise quick start. workflow: complete applied workflow. interop: interoperability sibling packages. lag-transition-networks: transition-network interpretation. confirmatory: evidence uncertainty workflow. plotting: plot gallery. Removed public documentation references unexported internals. Made long-format input flexible: action mandatory long-format column, optional actor, session, time, order. Added warnings single-sequence bootstrap permutation cases requested procedure limited inferential meaning.

title: lagdynamics 0.2.0
text: Added Dynalytics-style confirmatory evidence battery: certainty_lsa(), bootstrap_lsa(), reliability_lsa(), stability_lsa(), permute_lsa(). Added group comparison compare_lsa() Bayesian group comparison bayes_compare_lsa(). Added grouped lsa() fits group = ..., grouped methods transitions(), nodes(), tests(), initial(), plotting, reliability, comparison workflows. Added tidy .data.frame() methods inference comparison result objects. Added unified plotting surface: residual heatmaps, residual networks, TNA probability networks, chord diagrams, sunbursts, uncertainty forests, group-comparison plots. Added native transition initial probabilities: transition_probabilities() initial(). Added bundled long-format data examples tests.

title: lagdynamics 0.1.0
text: Created -scratch, clean-room implementation lag sequential analysis categorical event sequences. Added unified lsa() constructor canonical sequence handling lsa_data() lsa_transitions(). Added five built-engines: classical, two_cell, bidirectional, parallel_dominance, nonparallel_dominance. Added convenience wrappers: lsa_classical(), lsa_two_cell(), lsa_bidirectional(), lsa_parallel_dominance(), lsa_nonparallel_dominance(). Added pluggable engine registry: register_lsa_engine(), get_lsa_engine(), list_lsa_engines(), unregister_lsa_engine(). Added tidy reading verbs: transitions(), nodes(), tests(), initial(), summary(). Added multi-lag helpers lsa_lags() lag_profile(). Added structural-zero handling loops = FALSE arbitrary structural-zero matrices. Added experimental transfer_entropy() directed categorical information-flow analysis. Kept runtime dependencies minimal: base R packages imported (grDevices, grid, stats, utils).
